text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days before the Takarazuka Kinen, 
Sirius Symboli receives heartfelt 
encouragement from her juniors.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To answer their hopes and feelings, Sirius 
Symboli set her sights on the Takarazuka 
Kinen.
